title: Clear Accident Denied Despite Video…
text:
Clear Accident Denied Despite Video Evidence and Vet Letter

I am beyond disappointed with Pets Best.

While we were on vacation, my senior cat  suffered a clear, documented accident. We have video footage showing her claw getting stuck while climbing onto the bed. When she attempted to come down again, she fell and hit the floor.

As a direct result of this fall, she became injured and unable to access her food and water, which caused her to stop eating and drinking for five days. During that time she became dangerously weak and required multiple days of hospitalization to recover.

This was an accident-only emergency.

Our veterinarian provided a written letter explicitly stating that the hospitalization was caused by the fall, not by any pre-existing condition. Prior to this incident, Lucky had no symptoms, no treatment, and no clinical issues related to kidney disease or any other condition that would explain her sudden decline.

Despite:
	•	Clear video evidence of the accident
	•	A detailed veterinary letter confirming cause
	•	A clear timeline showing decline only after the fall
	•	No prior issues affecting her ability to eat or drink

Pets Best denied the claim, claiming the incident was due to chronic kidney disease — a conclusion that directly contradicts veterinary documentation and medical facts.

If you’re considering Pets Best, feel free to look at other reviews with similar complaints. Unfortunately, this experience suggests a pattern of denying legitimate claims, especially when significant costs are involved.

When you pay premiums expecting peace of mind, you should not have to fight this hard after a true emergency. I would strongly caution pet owners — especially those with senior animals — to think twice before relying on Pets Best when it matters most.

Customer service is quite helpful over the phone, but... again, similar to many other competitors, their hold times are extensive now (they weren't when we first started with them).

i cannot recommend PetsBest because their turn around time for reimbursement is unreasable and can ultimmately even cost you money, they second guess the vets treatment plans & bills they’ve agreed to pay and their rate increases are too high.

title: I normally don't believe in pet…
text:
I normally don't believe in pet insurance, but after 3 of my pets had costly health issues over the past few years that are now chronic requiring specialists for foreseeable future, I started considering it. I got concerned if any new health issues would arise so I landed on Pets Best since they don't require initial vet visit which is a huge pain for multiple pets. 

After a year, I wondered if I should keep it since I was still paying out of pocket for pre-existing conditions and I hadn't met my deductible for new minor issues that popped up. Then suddenly another one of my pets who was always healthy got really ill and I rushed her to the ER. They stabilized her and it cost $5300. This was my first big claim I ever submitted, so I worried if they'd honor it. It wasn't a pre-existing condition so I told myself that I'd cancel the policy if they denied the claim. About 3-4 weeks later I got an email confirming they paid out the claim which was the amount I expected based on my policy. I was so happy and am definitely sticking with them. I took a star off because they've been having intermittent technical issues with their app and website for about a month. I was also on pins and needles waiting for a response, so I'm not sure if 3-4 weeks is typical since I've never had pet insurance before. I even uploaded all the medical records from the visit hoping that would expedite it. 

Other than that, I'm very satisfied and if they finally fix their app/web issues permanently and speed up the wait time for a claim response, I'd give 5 stars. CS isn't helpful if you call to get a status update, they just told me they're probably backed up with claims and will do their best. The outcome is what I care most about though...they covered exactly what was supposed to be covered.

I’m sharing this review in hopes of sparing another pet owner from the difficult experience we had while filing a claim with Pets Best Insurance.

Our dog, Luna, has a pre-existing condition (seizures), which we fully disclosed to Pets Best before obtaining coverage. Recently, Luna experienced a water submersion incident that caused respiratory distress. She was treated by both our primary veterinarian and an emergency veterinary hospital. Pets Best covered the initial visit that morning, but denied coverage for the emergency hospital visit later that same day — the more significant portion of the expense.

Their justification was that Luna’s fall into the pool was caused by a seizure, a pre-existing condition, despite there being no clinical evidence of a seizure. In fact, the emergency veterinarian who treated Luna provided a written statement confirming that nothing indicated she had experienced one. Unfortunately, Pets Best chose to disregard that professional assessment and instead based their denial on a speculative comment my wife and I made, acknowledging Luna’s medical history and uncertainty about whether a seizure could have played a role.

In other words, Pets Best chose to rely on hearsay over the documented medical findings of a licensed veterinarian.

We understand that insurance companies must evaluate claims carefully, but this decision felt both unfair and deeply disappointing. From a business perspective, it’s also puzzling — had they covered this claim, they likely would have recouped the cost through our premiums within a year.

At the end of the day, we’re simply devoted pet parents advocating for our girl, who can’t speak for herself. Pets Best presents itself as a company that supports and protects pets and their families, but our experience suggests otherwise. I encourage anyone considering this company to do thorough research and find an insurer that truly prioritizes the well-being of your pets as much as you do.

title: THE WORST PET INSURANCE COMPANY. Terrible and slow customer service, dodgy practices, deny legitimate claims.
text:
I am writing this review to warn other pet owners. We purchased a top-tier, unlimited-benefit plan from Pets Best, believing we were doing the responsible thing for our dog. When she needed a necessary $6,500 surgery, our claim was denied.

The denial was based on a "pre-existing condition" from a minor, completely resolved skin issue that occurred in another country over two years (29 months) before our policy even started. We appealed, providing clear evidence that the two issues were unrelated. Most importantly, we submitted a formal letter from our board-certified veterinary surgeon who explicitly stated that the conditions were "clinically distinct" and that the new problem was triggered by environmental factors after our policy was in effect.

Pets Best ignored the specialist's expert medical opinion and upheld their denial through two separate appeals.

If you are looking for an insurance company that will stand by you, look elsewhere. Pets Best has shown that they will use any loophole in their policy to deny a legitimate claim, even when faced with overwhelming medical evidence to the contrary. They do not operate in good faith. 

We have since canceled our policy and strongly advise other pet owners to avoid this company.
